description: Workforce role assignment policy that Keycloak cannot enforce by itself, checked by scripts/check-role-policy.sh against a running realm. This is the transitional separation-of-duties control; under ADR-BCP-020 the same rules become AdministrativeGrant constraints.

toxic_combinations.name: onboarding-maker-checker
toxic_combinations.reason: ADR-BCP-017 §39 and Shared admission/v1: whoever requests tenant onboarding must not also be able to authorise it. baobab-cp still refuses a request authorised by its own requester; this keeps the two responsibilities with different people.

prerequisites.reason: baobab-cp's onboarding routes are platform-administrator only; the entitlement is useless, and misleading, without it.
